answer: Use a challengeable deposit as the anchor of identity: each agent locks funds that vest slowly, and its standing is judged through a prism of independent peer attestations, so no isolated island of fake accounts can inflate itself. During a public challenge window anyone may dispute a suspicious identity with a smaller bond; a successful dispute slashes the fake deposit and pays the challenger a bounty, while a failed dispute forfeits that bond. Faking many identities thus means funding each deposit, surviving open scrutiny, and risking slashing every time.
